# mondoo_integration_error_notification (Resource)

Sends an alert when an integration moves to an error state, by email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, or webhook. Works with every integration type.

An integration has at most one alert. Creating this resource replaces any alert the integration already has, and destroying it turns the alert off.

The alert is a workflow, which you can see in the workflows view of the Mondoo console. Deleting or disabling that workflow in the console turns the alert off, and the next apply turns it back on.

Managing this resource requires permission to create and delete workflows in the integration's space.

~> **Note:** The API never returns the alert's `target`, because a webhook URL works as a secret. Terraform detects a changed `channel` or an alert turned off outside of Terraform, but not a target changed in the console.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "shodan_token" {
  description = "The Shodan Token"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  description = "Incoming-webhook URL of the Slack channel that receives the alert"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

resource "mondoo_integration_shodan" "shodan_integration" {
  name    = "Shodan Integration"
  targets = ["mondoo.com"]

  credentials = {
    token = var.shodan_token
  }
}

# Alert a Slack channel when the integration moves to an error state.
resource "mondoo_integration_error_notification" "shodan_alert" {
  integration_mrn = mondoo_integration_shodan.shodan_integration.mrn
  channel         = "SLACK"
  target          = var.slack_webhook_url
}

# Or send the alert by email.
resource "mondoo_integration_error_notification" "aws_alert" {
  integration_mrn = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
  channel         = "EMAIL"
  target          = "ops@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) Where to deliver the alert: `EMAIL`, `SLACK`, `TEAMS`, or `WEBHOOK`.
- `integration_mrn` (String) The Mondoo Resource Name (MRN) of the integration to alert on, such as `mondoo_integration_aws.example.mrn`.
- `target` (String, Sensitive) The email address (`EMAIL`), or the incoming-webhook URL (`SLACK`, `TEAMS`, `WEBHOOK`).

### Read-Only

- `workflow_mrn` (String) The MRN of the workflow that sends the alert.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an integration's alert by the integration's MRN. The API does not
# return the alert's target, so the first apply after the import sets it.
terraform import mondoo_integration_error_notification.shodan_alert "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
